rule.name: permit-all
rule.comment: Allow 'admin' group complete access to all operations and data.

rule.name: permit-get-schema
rule.comment: All users can fetch YANG modules over NETCONF.

rule.name: permit-bridge-fdb
rule.comment: All users can list the bridge forwarding database.

rule.name: permit-radio-scan
rule.comment: All users can scan for Wi-Fi networks.

rule.name: permit-radio-survey
rule.comment: All users can survey Wi-Fi channels.

rule.name: permit-system-rpcs
rule.comment: Operators can reboot, shutdown, and set system time.

rule.name: permit-interfaces
rule.comment: Operators can configure interfaces.

rule.name: permit-routing
rule.comment: Operators can configure routing.

rule.name: permit-firewall
rule.comment: Operators can configure the firewall.

rule.name: permit-dhcp-server
rule.comment: Operators can configure the DHCP server.

rule.name: permit-lldp
rule.comment: Operators can configure LLDP.

rule.name: permit-hostname
rule.comment: Operators can set the hostname.

rule.name: permit-contact
rule.comment: Operators can set the contact.

rule.name: permit-location
rule.comment: Operators can set the location.

rule.name: permit-clock
rule.comment: Operators can set the time zone.

rule.name: permit-dhcp-server-clear
rule.comment: Operators can clear the DHCP server statistics.

rule.name: permit-address-set-add
rule.comment: Operators can add dynamic entries to a firewall address set.

rule.name: permit-address-set-remove
rule.comment: Operators can remove dynamic entries from a firewall address set.

rule.name: permit-address-set-flush
rule.comment: Operators can flush the dynamic entries of a firewall address set.

rule.name: permit-edit-config
rule.comment: Operators can change configuration over NETCONF.

rule.name: permit-edit-data
rule.comment: Operators can change configuration over NETCONF.

rule.name: permit-lock
rule.comment: Operators can lock a datastore over NETCONF.

rule.name: permit-unlock
rule.comment: Operators can unlock a datastore over NETCONF.

rule.name: permit-commit
rule.comment: Operators can commit the candidate over NETCONF.

rule.name: permit-discard-changes
rule.comment: Operators can discard candidate changes over NETCONF.

rule.name: permit-validate
rule.comment: Operators can validate configuration over NETCONF.

rule.name: permit-copy-config
rule.comment: Operators can save configuration over NETCONF.

rule.name: deny-all-write+exec
rule.comment: Guests cannot change anything or exec rpcs.

rule.name: deny-password-access
rule.comment: No user except admins can access password hashes.

rule.name: deny-keystore-access
rule.comment: No user except admins can access cryptographic keys.

rule.name: deny-truststore-access
rule.comment: No user except admins can access trust store.
